reader_summary.headline: Hello and welcome to The Insight by Oak Tree Capital.
reader_summary.overview: Hello and welcome to The Insight by Oak Tree Capital. I'm Anna Schumansky, Oakry's senior financial writer, and today we have something a little bit different for you. We've put together three excerpts from Oak Tree's recent client conference.

key_points.text: First up, we have co-chairman Howard Marks.
key_points.evidence_quote: First up, we have co-chairman Howard Marks, who will set the stage with his discussion about the massive changes we've been seeing in financial markets in recent years.

key_points.text: We'll then hear from members of Oak Tree's global credit team who will explain how these changes are impacting performance.
key_points.evidence_quote: We'll then hear from members of Oak Tree's global credit team who will explain how these changes are impacting performance.

key_points.text: And finally, you'll hear from Oak Tree's global opportunities team who'll discuss today's restructuring landscape.
key_points.evidence_quote: And finally, you'll hear from Oak Tree's global opportunities team who'll discuss today's restructuring landscape.

key_points.text: So with that, I'll turn it over to Howard.
